summary: Iter47: Location sharing with coins. Backend 11/11 pytest pass (2-coin deduction always incl. brand-new user inside free quota, 32-hex unique token, expires_at=created+5min, 402 blocked w/ no message + coins unchanged, 400 missing lat/lng, parallel double-spend -> only 1 success, /api/loc valid/410/404, messages list location:null+location_expired after expiry, live update + WS location_update to recipient, non-sender/non-live 404, stop -> 410 + WS expired, 422 bad coords). Frontend (390x844, geolocation granted) all flows pass: picker shows cost+balance, live share deducts 2 (237->235) with toast, LIVE badge, countdown decreasing (4:57->4:55), stop button only for sender; custom pin via map click + place name deducts 2; recipient tap opens new tab google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=lat,lng&origin=... and shows distance toast + location-distance (9.5 km); live update via API moves recipient's map without reload (tiles changed); stop -> bubble becomes location-expired instantly; expired bubble has no open action; <2 coins -> toast 'Недостаточно монет...' + redirect /premium, picker not opened; /l/<token> valid redirects to Google Maps, expired -> 'Срок действия ссылки на локацию истёк', unknown -> 'Ссылка не найдена'. Regression: text send, delete-for-everyone (text + location; deleted location link -> 404) OK. Media viewer not re-tested.

ui_bugs.issue: User-entered place name is passed through tx() auto-translation: 'TEST_pin_cafe' rendered as 'ТЕСТ_пин_кафе' (transliterated) for both sender and recipient. Place names should probably be shown verbatim (or only translated when the viewer's language differs).
For a fast 404 the raw i18n key 'chat.loc_link_missing' flashes briefly before i18n strings load (resolves after ~1s).

action_items: (Low) Don't transliterate/translate user-entered location place names in LocationBubble (ChatRoomPage passes place={tx(m.location?.place)})
(Low) LocationLinkPage: show a spinner until i18n strings are loaded or provide a fallback string to avoid raw key flash
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/chats/{other}/send has no match/block check in _do_send_message — any authenticated user can send (incl. location) to any user_id (pre-existing; verify intended).

Recipient-side locked messages (non-premium beyond free quota) strip location correctly; WS broadcast_message sends full msg incl. token to recipient regardless of lock — check if a locked recipient could read location token via WS.
LocationLinkPage redirects immediately (window.location.href) so the distance text is visible only for a moment — acceptable but the distance is effectively not shown on /l/ page.
